== Historical source verification ==
This is the complete native June 2023 edition of the Players Committee’s Virtual Set 21 release sheet. The recorded 200-status archive entry at [https://web.archive.org/web/20230626152641/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf 26 June 2023] identifies the original publisher address [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-21.pdf Virtual Set 21 release sheet] and the SHA-1 base32 digest <code>I5KAFQNQTE3EBF52CCXTLOMBGSLL6DJQ</code>. The retained complete PDF matches that digest; its SHA-256 is <code>a724f9b7e9e545191dd2db63b7e42cfd5426f0ce12958fb0bb8815d4b3d1eb4d</code> and its size is 15,744,534 bytes. All eight pages print the June 2023 footer.

The host subsequently replaced this file with a December 2023 edition. The separately identifiable June edition is the source for the exact matching June printed slip articles. The captured date provides a by-date for that printing, not a claim about the first day of distribution.
